photo_reel.note: Any Reel whose visuals are AI-generated photoreal imagery (video OR a cut sequence of stills) stays closed until ALL THREE: (1) [SATISFIED 2026-09-05, Group Legal -- income-engine docs/consults/2026-09-05-group-legal-nuvarel-ai-disclosure-read.md] Meta's `is_ai_generated=true` container parameter (wired in scripts/publish_due_posts.py, opt-in via queue JSON `ai_generated: true`) satisfies the Misinformation-standard disclosure duty on AI photoreal video -- confirmed, nothing else needs to accompany it. (2) [OPEN] a stills-to-Reel build path exists and one Quick Games Reel has passed a frame-level review. Photoreal VIDEO generation itself is separately unproven (~2h GPU/clip). (3) [OPEN, new 2026-09-05, Group Legal -- standing-note P26] disclosure alone does not clear a Reel that DEMONSTRATES a physical outcome (a cushion recovering, a board revealing grain) -- generated footage of a physical event is a fabricated evidentiary claim on an account whose positioning is 'the proof, not the claim,' independent of the legal disclosure question. Per-piece requirement once (1)+(2) are met: any demonstration-type Reel must be either genuinely filmed, or reframed so the generated imagery illustrates rather than claims to record an event (caption language must not assert the depicted event occurred). Object/material-study Reels (no claimed physical outcome) are not subject to this condition.

inspection_hands.note: The Inspection (hands-only device) is NOT settled. [RESOLVED 2026-09-05, founder decision] Real filmed hand, not AI-generated -- resolves both the 'thumb along a seam' render-reliability failure (0/10) and the AI-disclosure question for this device (Group Legal, 2026-09-05: a real hand is outside Meta's AI-people policy and outside is_ai_generated by construction). [STILL OPEN] CCO gesture vocabulary not yet ratified (the original 'thumb along a seam' gesture is out, no replacement chosen); the hand hasn't actually been filmed yet. Do not open this gate until real footage exists and CCO has signed off on the gesture. Note (Group Legal, 2026-09-05): if this ever reopens with an AI-generated hand instead, `ai_generated: true` on those pieces is NOT discretionary -- a photoreal human hand is India SGI under Rule 2(1)(wa) (standing-note P26) regardless of the Meta-side question.
